Ichijou"...What have we got against it?"
Masamune《One thing only.》
Ichijou"What?"
Masamune《His Divine Art shall be met with ours.》
Ichijou"...Your mechanisms?"
Masamune《No. Divine Arts, those are not. Merely functions achieved by Masamune's ingenuity with armor plate.》
Masamune《The Divine Art engraved upon my heartsteel is another matter.》
Ichijou"Use that, and we win. Pakka?"
Masamune《Indeed! Defeat is not for Masamune.》
Ichijou"Good. My part—what do I do?"
Masamune《Mm. Shortly, hellfire shall rain from the heavens and burn us to the very marrow—but—》
Ichijou"Yeah."
Masamune《Do nothing.》
Ichijou"...What?"
Masamune《DO NOTHING.》
Ichijou"..."
Ichijou"That much only?"
Masamune《One more thing.》
Ichijou"What?"
Masamune《Take care not to die.》
Ichijou"........................"
Masamune《Let Mido remain alive until the end—and victory belongs to us, Masamune!》
